disposition: Engine contract is implemented and tested; live BaoStock values remain excluded from formal turnover context.

live_capability.reason: No independently accepted tolerance or provider denominator semantics; live target fingerprints conflict.

metrics.turnover_delta3: current rate minus the third prior strict actual-traded sample; unavailable if endpoint missing
metrics.turnover_ma5: mean of the five most recent prior strict actual-traded samples
metrics.turnover_median20: median of the twenty most recent prior strict actual-traded samples
metrics.turnover_pct20: midpoint empirical percentile of current rate among twenty prior strict samples
metrics.turnover_pct5: midpoint empirical percentile of current rate among five prior strict samples
metrics.turnover_pct60: midpoint empirical percentile of current rate among sixty prior strict samples
metrics.turnover_ratio20: current turnover_rate / turnover_median20; unavailable when denominator <= 0
